maddeler.e:
نتهاتف (form VI)
# نَتَهَاتَفُ (natahātafu) /na.ta.haː.ta.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
# نَتَهَاتَفَ (natahātafa) /na.ta.haː.ta.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
# نَتَهَاتَفْ (natahātaf) /na.ta.haː.taf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
